prompts.title: Upcoming at Family Church Students
prompts.setup: Lead these current ministry announcements with warmth and clarity. State only the details shown; do not guess a price or registration detail.

events.name: Middle School Sundays
events.detail: Middle school students gather for teaching and connection, with worship service options at 8:30 or 11:00 AM.
events.action: Invite a middle school friend this Sunday and connect with a leader at check-in.

events.name: Join our BAND app
events.when: Ongoing · get the current ministry updates
events.detail: BAND is where our student ministry shares announcements and keeps families connected across the week. Join at band.us/n/aaafbdF364s34. An admin approves each join request.
events.action: Join Family Students (WN) on BAND at band.us/n/aaafbdF364s34.

events.name: Pumpkin Party
events.detail: Pumpkin Party is this Wednesday, October 28, from 6 to 8 PM. Build a team of five and bring a pumpkin that weighs 10 pounds or more. It's also costume night, so come dressed up.
events.action: Get your team of five together and pick out a 10+ lb pumpkin.

events.name: 24-Hour Prayer
events.when: Friday, October 30, 12:00 PM – Saturday, October 31, 12:00 PM
events.detail: Our whole church is praying for 24 hours straight, from Friday at noon to Saturday at noon in the Windermere Chapel. Each hour has four prayer stations. Middle schoolers can take an hour any time Friday until 10 PM, and the best way to do it is with your family. Sign-ups are open now.
events.action: Ask your parents which hour you can take together, then sign up.

events.name: Upward Basketball (6th–8th grade)
events.when: Registration open · early pricing ends Friday, October 30 · final deadline Friday, November 13, 2026
events.detail: Family Church Upward Basketball now has a league for 6th through 8th grade. Player evaluations are November 3 or November 5, first practice is December 7, and first games are January 8 and 9.
events.action: Tell your parents today so they can register before early pricing ends October 30.

events.name: Student Friendsgiving
events.detail: Student Friendsgiving takes the place of our regular Wednesday that night. We'll eat together, share what we're thankful for, and hear a short message. Your friends don't need to bring anything.
events.action: Save November 18 and think of one friend who should be at your table.

events.name: Wednesday Nights at Lakeside
events.detail: Wednesday nights are where we hang out, worship together, and get into small groups. If you haven't been in a while, this is your week to come back, and bring a friend with you.
events.action: Come this Wednesday and bring a friend.
